title: Vercel CLI-managed authentication prepared
summary: Replace direct cached OAuth reads in 11 active SEO operational scripts with a shared CLI API adapter; validation pending. Historical release copies are preserved.

changes.detail: CLI owns OAuth refresh; requests use shell-free argument arrays and JSON stdin; no cached access-token reads, token argv, raw diagnostic output or mutation retries.
Regression coverage for endpoint restrictions, secret-safe input/output, parsing and direct-cache-reader prevention.
